audience: support teams that answer customers in NeetoDesk

useCases.title: Review tickets by status and owner
useCases.text: List tickets filtered by status, priority, assignee, customer or tags. Open one ticket to read its group, customer and custom fields.

useCases.title: Read the conversation on a ticket
useCases.text: List the comments and internal notes on a ticket, oldest first. Open one comment by its id.

useCases.title: Check ticket volume and response times
useCases.text: Read the ticket volume for a time window. Read the response and resolution times per agent and per team.

useCases.title: Read customer satisfaction results
useCases.text: Read the survey results for a time window, with the number of responses for each rating option.

useCases.title: Update a ticket
useCases.text: Change a ticket's status, priority, group, assignee or due date. Trash, spam and moved statuses are refused here.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to a ticket
useCases.text: Add an internal note that agents see. The customer does not receive it by email. The server never sends customer replies.
